built.brief.py: One GOAL brief from reading's MEANING options: FIXED part (one sha256 b6afbd1712c3..., no owner data); message 4 is a fence (<<<DESK WORDS ... DESK WORDS>>>) holding the request and numbered options, with fence marks escaped; only licensed options kept (some clause names them); buttons(b) = exactly the options + 'None of these'. Registered as TurnKind GOAL/1 in 0.8.7's turns.py (switch understanding, grammar picks 1..3 or 0, answer cap 6, deadline 20 s, parse model_words.options, check answer_check.check_pick, fallback ASK_OWNER with the buttons). Token size: exact with the 4B's vocabulary read from a GGUF header (vocabulary(path), byte-level BPE, the model is never loaded), else an estimate that errs high.
built.answer_check.py: check_pick: shape, licence (a clause holds the option's naming words and one of its verbs; unbacked picks trimmed; nothing left refused), authority (revision-only twin not named by the request refused), coverage (UNSETTLED), joint plan (planner.plan). check_words: WORDS check. marks/margin/page: the page check with ON_DESK, MADE_FROM, ROUNDED, DIFFERS, UNIT_SLIP, NOT_ON_DESK, NOT_CHECKED; days too. Fraction only, no float, field_doubt not used. New read op pages.marks. replay() judges the recorded answers.
built.phrases.py: Phrasebook rows in the instruction matrix (operation requests.read, the observed kind 'reading', shape 'phrase:'). phrases.list (read); phrases.keep and phrases.strike (approve: the owner's press; her read-only principal cannot; no dial lists them); phrases.forget (approve, '*.forget' always asks) leaves a tombstone (date + digest, no words). keep refuses any reading that is not a read or a window move. Follows CURRENT (re-pointed to the current revision, says so) or THIS_REVISION (stays, says so). Struck phrases never used or offered again. requests.read now passes the phrasebook to reading.read (KEPT route, acts navigates, model_calls 0).
built.instruction_matrix.py: The kit cutter: phrase rows excluded from examples (given to a model), patterns, the training-set export and status counts (status gains phrasebook_rows); matrix.forget turns phrase rows into tombstones.
built.her_hand_qt.py: GOAL section rewritten: kept phrase -> start with no question ('Read as you kept it · model calls: 0'); else brief.desk; no model -> buttons exactly the brief's options + None of these, the press is the owner's approval (choose()); with a model -> turns.ask(brief.GOAL) on a thread, polled; TAKEN/TRIMMED -> start, 'The model's pick, checked against your words · model calls: 1', fold 'What I asked the model' (words sent, size, seconds, raw answer, check); LATE -> top option taken by default only if it is a read/window move and the dial is Do and show or Free hand, else buttons; refused/unsettled -> buttons. After a pick or a press: one keep offer ('Keep “pop … up” as trace?', with follow-current / stay choice when a revisioned sheet is named).

decisions_where_the_plan_was_silent: GOAL is registered in 0.8.7's turn contract (as the brief asked): the answer is a terse line '1', '1 2' or '0' under the contract's grammar, not the half-build's JSON; the deadline is the contract's foreground cap of 20 s rather than the design's 60 s. answer_check.shape also reads the half-build's JSON form, so the recordings replay. If a 0.8.7 builder registers another GOAL kind, turns.register will refuse the second one (TURN_KIND_TAKEN): merge them.

A pick is backed only by a clause holding both what the option names and one of its verbs. So for 'pop the bench readings' trace up' the pick 'Select it' is refused (no select verb) and the buttons decide; offering it as a button is still licensed (the clause names the sheet).
Late default: a window move (navigation) counts as a read, as the half-build already did; a change is never a default.
No 'kit cutter' exists in the code; the training-set export (matrix.export), the in-context examples given to a model, patterns and status are where phrase rows are now cut out.

The 4B model file is not in this container, so the 300-token check used the estimate (calibrated on the recorded prompts: it gave 283 to 293 where the 4B counted 275 to 286). brief.vocabulary(path) counts exactly once the file is given.

The recorded answers (wip/2026-11-14/hand_s1/build_record/model) were copied with the sheet titles written as Rail Demo's ('07 ...' names replaced) into tests_integrated/data/everyday/goal_answers_recorded.json, so the replay needs nothing from wip/.

The page check gathers sheet values from reviewed rows (with the reviewed reading as what the place said before) and calculation results (with the Field's moved results); day values are supported by marks() but desk_values does not yet gather Home Demo's computed last days.
